agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday, July 23, 2025 in Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee Report 26.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, July 2nd, 2025, and the deadline to register by email to speak is 9:00 am on Thursday, July 3rd, 2025.
agenda_items.minutes:
The Chair read the following statement at the outset of the meeting pursuant to the Planning Act:
This is a public meeting to consider the proposed Zoning By-law Amendments listed as Item(s) 5.1 and 5.2 on today’s Agenda.
For the item just mentioned, only those who make oral submissions today or written submissions before the amendments are adopted may appeal the matter to the Ontario Land Tribunal. In addition, the applicant may appeal the matter to the Ontario Land Tribunal if Council does not adopt an amendment within 90 days of receipt of the application for a Zoning By-law Amendment and 120 days for an Official Plan Amendment.
To submit written comments on these amendments, prior to their consideration by City Council on July 23, 2025, please email or call the Committee or Council Coordinator.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Councillor Kitts introduced the following Direction to Staff:
Direction to staff (Councillor C. Kitts):
That resources and ongoing training be provided to departments to support staff in identifying reports and matters that have significant or distinct rural implications that should be considered by the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee.
The Committee then heard from Ms Kathy Black.  Ms Caitlin Salter MacDonald, City Clerk, was present to respond to questions. 
The report recommendations were then put before Committee and were “Carried”, as presented, along with the above Direction to Staff, which staff agreed to take on.

motions.motion_text:
Report Recommendation(s)
That the Agriculture and Rural Affairs Committee recommend Council approve its revised Terms of Reference, as outlined in this report and attached as Document 1.

sub_agendas_items.title: Engineer’s Report amendments to the Wilson-Cowan Municipal Drain – Court of Revision

attachments.attachment_title: Report - W-C MD Court of Revision.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Court of Revision was convened at 10:36 a.m.
The Chair read the following statement at the beginning of the hearing for the Wilson-Cowan Municipal Drain:
The Court of Revision is now open for the purpose of hearing appeals under Section 52 of the Drainage Act by owners of land assessed for drainage works under the engineer’s report for the Wilson-Cowan Municipal Drain dated April 2025, this court will now convene for the 1st sitting of the Court of Revision under Section 46 of the Drainage Act.
The following appeals (held on file with the Office of the City Clerk) have been received by the Clerk:
Any other owner of lands assessed under the Engineer’s Report who has not provided written notice of appeal to the Clerk in advance of this hearing, should identify themselves to the Clerk’s Assistant at this time with a request to be heard. 
Each of the above appellants was accorded five minutes to provide information supporting their appeal.  Mr.   Dave Ryan spoke on behalf of the City of Ottawa.  Mr. William Seabrook spoke on behalf of 969230 Ontario Inc.
At the conclusion of the hearing, the Chair stated the following
The decision of the Court of Revision with respect to the Wilson-Cowan Municipal Drain is as follows:
This court accepts the appeal from the City of Ottawa and orders the assessment schedules to be updated accordingly.The appeal filed by Mr. Seabrook on behalf of 96930 is denied.  This court adopts the assessments in Engineer’s Report dated April 2025.
The decision rendered by this court may be appealed to the Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Appeal Tribunal within 21 days of today, July 3, 2025.
The Court of Revision was adjourned at 11:05 a.m.
